API Changes

  • The statestore-datastore artifact is had added support for the following platforms: desktop, linux, mac, ios, tvos, watchos, js, and wasmJs. In order to enable this, instead of using reflection, PersistToDataStore is now generic in the persisted value type and requires the key to provide the name it is stored under and its KSerializer. (I4cd8e, I03124, b/579492485)

entries.name: Appstate Transform
entries.html:
API Changes

  • AppState Transform has added support for SavedStateContainer that enables the use of rememberSaveable inside of the @Composable lambda. The ensures that all of the state inside the transform is not saved across configuration changes and process death. (Ia66ea)
  • AppState Transform now provides a RunnableTransformScope that provides a public run function to kick off the scope while the default TransformScope interface can continue to be used for launchTransform with the assumption that the scope is already running. (Ia1f0d)

entries.name: Benchmark
entries.html:
Bug Fixes

  • Add support for toggling categories when enabling in-process tracing from benchmarks for a target process. PerfettoTraceRule now supports enabling optional categories for in-process tracing. These categories are used by the TraceDriver instance in the target process. (I663ed, b/565040771)

  • Fixed thermal throttle logic to reset main thread deadlines after the cooldown sleep completes to avoid premature time limit errors. (Ibb2f02)

  • Swapped restricted API surface labels in metalava configuration to correctly align with atomic and non-atomic group definitions. (I0c563c, b/582384448)

  • Updated PerfettoCapture to wait for target process exit using am force-stop to ensure process stability during benchmarks. (If8a631)

  • Buffered file streams in PerfettoOutput to reduce total write counts and prevent file system exhaustion and timeouts. (I1c828c)

  • Updated AndroidX test library dependencies and fixed javadoc warning configurations to maintain build stability. (Ia7e3ff)

  • Transitioned build environment to JDK 25 and added necessary workarounds for compatibility, including JSpecify annotation removals and native access flags. (I88704c, b/559834169, b/445484245)

  • Ensured target packages are killed after in-process tracing is enabled when the process was not previously alive to maintain consistent cold-start tracing states. (Icef99b, b/568496084)

entries.name: CameraX
entries.html:
Important changes since 1.6.0:

1. Stabilized Camera2Interop (V2) & Kotlin DSL Builders

  • Camera2Interop V2 (Stable, No Opt-In Required): Redesigned Camera2Interop and removed the @ExperimentalCamera2Interop requirement on the new V2 APIs, providing type-safe, scope-specific configurator factory methods (Camera2Interop.forUseCase(), forImageCapture(), forSessionConfig(), and forCameraControl()) paired with setInterop() on Preview.Builder, ImageCapture.Builder, ImageAnalysis.Builder, VideoCapture.Builder, and SessionConfig.Builder, plus CameraControl.applyInteropAsync().
    • Added Kotlin DSL camera2Interop { ... } extension blocks for preview, imageCapture, imageAnalysis, videoCapture, and SessionConfig.Builder / sessionConfig, as well as CameraControl.applyCamera2Interop() (suspend) and CameraControl.applyCamera2InteropAsync().
    • Exposed granular interop scopes (UseCaseCamera2Interop, ImageCaptureCamera2Interop, SessionConfigCamera2Interop, and CameraControlCamera2Interop) providing structured access to OutputConfiguration settings (streamUseCase, mirrorMode, dynamicRangeProfile, physicalCameraId, sensorPixelModesUsed, surfaceGroupId, timestampBase), SessionConfiguration settings (sessionType, colorSpace, sessionParameter, sessionStateCallback), still capture options, and CameraCaptureSession / CameraDevice state callbacks.
    • Added helper methods and Kotlin extensions to retrieve Camera2 metadata and selectors directly: Camera2Interop.getCameraId(CameraInfo) (CameraInfo.cameraId), Camera2Interop.getCameraCharacteristics(CameraInfo) (CameraInfo.cameraCharacteristics), Camera2Interop.getCameraSelectorFromCameraId(String) (String.toCameraSelector()), and Camera2Interop.getCameraFilterFromCameraId(String).
    • Deprecated legacy Camera2Interop V1 classes (Camera2Interop.Extender, Camera2CameraControl, Camera2CameraInfo, and CaptureRequestOptions).
  • CameraX Kotlin DSL Builders: Added top-level Kotlin DSL factory functions for creating use cases and session configurations: preview { ... }, imageCapture { ... }, imageAnalysis { ... }, videoCapture(videoOutput) { ... }, sessionConfig(useCases) { ... }, highSpeedVideoSessionConfig(videoCapture) { ... }, and extensionSessionConfig(mode, extensionsManager) { ... }.

2. Compose Viewfinder Gesture, Screen Flash & Transformation Enhancements

  • Built-in Gestures, Screen Flash & Stream State in CameraXViewfinder: CameraXViewfinder in camera-compose now provides out-of-the-box support for pinch-to-zoom (isPinchToZoomEnabled, onZoomRatioChanged), tap-to-focus (isTapToFocusEnabled, onTapToFocus, autoCancelDurationMillis), screen flash (onScreenFlashReady), stream state monitoring (onStreamStateChanged with newly public Preview.STREAM_STATE_IDLE and Preview.STREAM_STATE_STREAMING), and surface release callbacks (onRelease).
  • FocusState & TransformationMode: Exposed FocusState (INACTIVE, STARTED, FOCUSED, NOT_FOCUSED, FAILED) in viewfinder-core to monitor tap-to-focus results, and added TransformationMode (DEFERRED, PRE_APPLIED) to TransformationInfo to ensure accurate viewfinder transformations in EMBEDDED mode when CameraX's OpenGL pipeline is active.

3. Video Capture & Audio Recording Enhancements

  • QHD (2K) Video Recording: Added Quality.QHD (2560×1440) and GroupableFeatures.QHD_RECORDING for 2K video capture and Feature Group queries.
  • Video & Audio Codec (MIME Type) Control: Introduced APIs for granular control over encoding formats:
    • Discover device-supported formats via experimental (@ExperimentalMimeTypeApi) Recorder.getSupportedVideoMimeTypes() and Recorder.getSupportedAudioMimeTypes().
    • Configure and inspect preferred formats via stable Recorder.Builder.setVideoMimeType(String), Recorder.Builder.setAudioMimeType(String), Recorder.getVideoMimeType(), and Recorder.getAudioMimeType().
    • Query codec-specific camera capabilities (such as supported qualities and dynamic ranges) via stable Recorder.getVideoCapabilities(CameraInfo, String).
  • Audio Channel Count & Bitrate Configuration: Added Recorder.Builder.setTargetAudioChannelCount(int) and Recorder.Builder.setTargetAudioEncodingBitRate(int) (along with Recorder.getTargetAudioChannelCount() and Recorder.getTargetAudioEncodingBitRate()) for explicit control over audio recording channels and bitrate.
  • Stabilized & Dynamic Mirror Mode: Stabilized Preview.Builder.setMirrorMode(int) (removing @ExperimentalMirrorMode) and added Preview.setMirrorMode(int), Preview.getMirrorMode(), and VideoCapture.setMirrorMode(int) to allow updating mirror mode dynamically.

4. Dynamic Concurrent Camera Composition & Visual Styling

  • Dynamic Composition Updates & Z-Order: Added ConcurrentCamera.setCompositionSettings(List<CompositionSettings>) to dynamically update Picture-in-Picture or split-screen layouts after binding to a lifecycle, and added CompositionSettings.Builder.setZOrder(int) and CompositionSettings.getZOrder() to control the rendering layer order of overlapping camera streams.
  • Frame Borders & Rounded Corners: Added setRoundedCornerRatio(float), setBorderWidthRatio(float), and setBorderColor(int) on CompositionSettings.Builder (along with getRoundedCornerRatio(), getBorderWidthRatio(), and getBorderColor() on CompositionSettings) to style concurrent camera frames with normalized rounded corners and colored borders.

5. GPU-Accelerated ImageAnalysis & Common Image Abstractions

  • PRIVATE Format & HardwareBuffer Access: Exposed ImageAnalysis.OUTPUT_IMAGE_FORMAT_PRIVATE, ImageAnalysis.getImageAnalysisCapabilities(CameraInfo).isOutputFormatSupported(int), and ImageProxy.getHardwareBuffer() as public APIs, enabling zero-copy GPU-based ImageAnalysis pipelines.
  • ImageWrapper & camera-common Abstractions: Introduced androidx.camera:camera-common and androidx.camera:camera-common-testing, providing common wrappers (ImageWrapper, ImagePlane with non-nullable ByteBuffer buffer, CameraCharacteristicsWrapper, CaptureRequestWrapper, CaptureResultWrapper) and test fakes (FakeImage, FakeCameraCharacteristics, etc.). ImageProxy and ImageProxy.PlaneProxy now implement ImageWrapper and ImagePlane.

6. Scene Detection, 3A Control, Physical Camera Binding & Auto-Rotation

  • Night Mode Indicator: Added CameraInfo.isNightModeIndicatorSupported(), CameraInfo.getNightModeIndicator(), and NightModeIndicator (UNKNOWN, NOT_RECOMMENDED, RECOMMENDED) to detect low-light scene conditions during standard capture sessions.
  • 3A Locking Mode in FocusMeteringAction: Added FocusMeteringAction.Builder.setLockingMode(int) and FocusMeteringAction.getLockingMode() to support locking AE/AWB (FLAG_AE, FLAG_AWB) or updating 3A metering regions without locking focus (FLAG_AF), allowing the camera to remain in continuous autofocus (CAF) mode while updating the focus area.
  • Physical Camera Selection & Binding: Added support for obtaining a CameraSelector for physical cameras from CameraInfo.getPhysicalCameraInfos() and binding UseCases directly to physical cameras. Querying CameraProvider.getCameraInfo() with a physical CameraSelector now returns the physical CameraInfo rather than the logical CameraInfo.
  • Automatic Sensor-Based Rotation (isAutoRotationEnabled): Added setAutoRotationEnabled(boolean) / isAutoRotationEnabled to SessionConfig.Builder, HighSpeedVideoSessionConfig.Builder, ExtensionSessionConfig.Builder, and CameraController to automatically update target output rotation from device sensors or disable the built-in rotation listener when needed.
  • Low Light Boost & Torch/Flash Interoperability: Low Light Boost and Torch now follow a "last setting wins" policy where enabling one automatically disables the other instead of rejecting the request. In addition, flash can now fire during ImageCapture while Low Light Boost is active.
  • Custom SessionConfig in CameraController: Exposed CameraController.setSessionConfig(SessionConfig, CameraSelector) to support binding custom SessionConfig instances with CameraController.
  • Extensions API Deprecation: Deprecated ExtensionsManager.getExtensionEnabledCameraSelector() in favor of ExtensionSessionConfig.

entries.name: camera viewfinder
entries.html:
Important changes since 1.6.0:

API Changes

  • Transformation Mode Support: Added the TransformationMode property to TransformationInfo to support apps using the OpenGL pipeline in EMBEDDED mode.
  • Focus State Tracking: Added FocusState and FocusMeteringState constants to the generic viewfinder core. Note: These constants were primarily introduced to support the new tap-to-focus and gesture capabilities in the higher-level CameraXViewfinder API, but they are exposed in the core modules for developers building custom viewfinder integrations who wish to model camera focus states.

Bug Fixes - Transformations Mirroring: Fixed a critical bug in the mirroring logic within Transformations. This ensures that surface-to-viewfinder matrix calculations correctly mirror the preview when using front-facing cameras or inverted setups.

entries.name: Compose Animation
entries.html:
Important changes since 1.12.0:

  • Deferred Transitions Stable: Promoted deferred transition APIs out of experimental. This includes DeferredTransitionState, rememberDeferredTransition, DeferredAnimatedContent, DeferredAnimatedVisibility, and TransformScope. (Ib6430, I7bb7e)
  • CapturedAnimatedVisibility: Introduced CapturedAnimatedVisibility. Disposes child composition immediately when hidden, and animates exit transitions by rendering the last captured frame on a GraphicsLayer. (I6c5b3)
  • Graduated Stable APIs: Promoted createChildTransition, Transition.Crossfade, veilOut, and unveilIn to stable APIs. EnterTransition.with has been removed; use togetherWith instead. (I38f66, Ied832, I9e3a3)
  • Transition Configurations: Made EnterExitTransitionConfig public on EnterTransition and ExitTransition. External libraries can now inspect EnterTransition and ExitTransition configurations to build custom transition support. (Idd5a4, b/330152398)
  • DeferredTargetAnimation.value: Exposed the current animated value as a public property on DeferredTargetAnimation. (Ie4f6e, b/434659224)
  • Seekable Transition Crash Fix: Fixed an issue in SeekableTransitionState where zero-duration or interrupted transitions could calculate NaN fractions and throw an IllegalArgumentException. (I8f3a9, b/555294641)

entries.name: Compose Animation
entries.html:
API Changes

  • Added ExperimentalAnimationCoreApi and ComposeAnimationCoreFlags.isSeekableTransitionStateStartAfterLayoutEnabled to guard starting SeekableTransitionState.animateTo after the target state has composed and completed layout. (I034e3, b/553804644)
  • Migrate Compose animation specs (FloatSpringSpec, FloatExponentialDecaySpec, KeyframesSpec, KeyframesWithSplineSpec, and SplineBasedFloatDecayAnimationSpec) to nanosecond precision, guarded by ComposeAnimationCoreFlags.isNanosecondAnimationSpecEnabled. (Ib9545)
  • Added SharedTransitionScope.DeferredTransitionBehavior (FollowContainer, Static, SeekToTarget), SharedContentConfig.deferredTransitionBehavior, and MutableContentTransform.sharedElementProgress to support seeking shared elements toward their target bounds during the deferred phase of a DeferredTransition. Deprecated permitTransformDuringDeferredTransition. (I2fac2)
  • Added InterruptionAwareAnimationSpec to allow pairing a FiniteAnimationSpec with a custom interruptionSpec (or itself) when a Transition, animate*AsState, or Animatable.animateTo animation is interrupted mid-flight. (If85e8)
  • Allow constructing MutableContentTransform from two MutableTransform instances via constructor. (I4054e)
  • Made SharedTransitionDefaults.EnterTransition, ExitTransition, and ResizeMode public. Added AnimatedContentDefaults with ContentTransform, SizeTransform, and SizeAnimationSpec. (Id912e)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where SeekableTransitionState.animateTo skipped initial animation frames when the target content had an expensive first composition or layout pass. (I383c6, b/553804644)
  • compileSdk for Compose UI and the Compose libraries that build against it (Animation, Foundation, Material 3, UI Test, UI Tooling, UI ViewBinding and Navigation3 UI) updated to 37.2. This will require transitively updating compileSdk for all apps and libraries using them. (I2859d)
  • When a MutableContentTransform or MutableTransform is provided during a deferred transition phase, transform properties that are not manually set now default to their resting values instead of the transition's initial values. (Ia79c4)
  • Shared elements sought via MutableContentTransform.sharedElementProgress now transfer their progress velocity to the bounds animation upon handoff. (I462c0)
  • Modifier.sharedElement now renders the incoming target element (pendingTargetState) during the deferred phase of a DeferredTransition while keeping its bounds anchored to the outgoing state until the transition commits. (If60c7)
  • Fixed an issue where shared elements nested under Modifier.animateEnterExit lost MutableContentTransform placement transformations on handoff from a deferred transition phase. (Icdcd7, b/572520922)

entries.name: Compose Foundation
entries.html:
API Changes

  • Removed ComposeFoundationFlags.isLinkMinimumTouchTargetSizeZeroEnabled. (Ib9226, b/572883859)
  • Added ComposeFoundationFlags.isLinkPerformanceOptimizationEnabled to control performance optimizations for LinkAnnotation in BasicText. The flag is off by default. (I8ac26, b/572883859)
  • Added new overloads of BasicText that accept a styleProvider (TextStyleScope.() -> Unit) lambda for dynamic styling, allowing dynamic style attributes to skip recomposition. (I88e20)
  • Removed ComposeFoundationFlags.isLinkMinimumTouchTargetSizeZeroEnabled. (I046d5, b/572883859)
  • Added ComposeFoundationFlags.isLinkPerformanceOptimizationEnabled to control performance optimizations for LinkAnnotation in BasicText. (I64a0f, b/572883859)
  • Added an onTextChanged callback to TextFieldState and rememberTextFieldState. It is called with the new text after each change to the text. (Iaabf5, b/552879150)
  • Removed the feature flag ComposeFoundationFlags.isAbsorbNonGestureNestedScrollInPagerFixEnabled (I0a387)
  • Modifier.border uses a more efficient implementation for rendering generic shapes (such as polygon shapes) on API 28 and above. This causes minor antialiasing differences that may require updating screenshot tests. To temporarily disable this, use ComposeFoundationFlags.isBorderUsesGraphicsLayerForGenericShapesEnabled (I3b917)
  • Added rememberStyleResolver() that should be used instead of remembering a StyleResolver() instance directy to ensure that the same style resolver is used even if the style and styleState used are modified. This prevents animations from being cancel because style style lambda instance was replaced. (I946b0)
  • Added TextContextMenuKeys.LookUpKey to support the new 'Look Up' context menu item. (I088ca)
  • Added DrawAnnotation for custom drawing behind and over AnnotatedString text ranges. (I928bf)
  • Exposed crossAxisCellCount on LazyGridItemScope to provide the number of cross-axis cells (columns in vertical grids or rows in horizontal grids) to item content. (I89f78, b/183187002)
  • The styleable() modifier API has been replaced by the styleResolver modifier based API. All styleable() modifiers and associated types (such as Style and StyleScope) have been deprecated. (I54677)
  • Fixed an issue in BasicSecureTextField where multi-codepoint emojis in the input text were obfuscated or revealed as multiple characters instead of a single glyph. (I91e44)
  • Added multiTouchSwipeWithVelocity to TouchInjectionScope to allow testing multi-touch gestures with a specific end velocity. (If0966)
  • Adds BorderRenderer, an API that enables drawing borders identical to Modifier.border within any draw scope, such as within a DrawModifierNode. This enables advanced border rendering and efficient animations alongside other drawing operations / transformations. See the samples for more information. (I2d259, b/548628030)
  • Modifier.border now consistently uses the outline size when rendering borders. Use ComposeFoundationFlags.isBorderMatchesOutlineBoundsFixEnabled to temporarily disable this if it causes issues. (I3e171)
  • Removes experimental feature flag ComposeUiFlags.isTrackpadPanHoverFixEnabled. (I3aa5b)
  • Added ComposeFoundationFlags.isNewBorderImplementationEnabled - this flag will be used to disable the new border rendering implementation inside Modifier.border. If you run into issues and need to disable this flag, please file a bug. (I98e90)
  • Added isLazyLayoutItemAnimationEnterExitTransitionsEnabled compose flag. When enabled, lazy layout item animations use a state-based enter and exit transition model instead of boolean-based fade tracking. (Ibde5d)
  • Removed AndroidComposeFoundationFlags.isOverscrollPixelRoundingEnabled flag (I0e3e0)
  • Fixes an edge case bug with rendering certain rounded rectangle outlines in Modifier.border. ComposeFoundationFlags.isRoundedRectangleBorderRenderingFixEnabled can be used to disable this change if it causes issues. (I19141)

Bug Fixes

  • Improved composition and node overhead of LinkAnnotation in BasicText by consolidating per-link modifiers into a single TextLinkNode. (I1e93b, b/572883859)
  • Improved composition performance of LinkAnnotation in BasicText by avoiding unnecessary coroutine and MutableInteractionSource allocations when stateful link styles are not used. (Ib036d, b/572883859)
  • Fixed a bug where simultaneous stateful styles on multiple LinkAnnotations in BasicText overwrote each other, and improved styling performance from O(N^2) to O(N). (I07a27, b/572883859)
  • Improved drawing and hit-testing performance of single-line LinkAnnotations in BasicText by bypassing unnecessary path clipping. (I70379, b/572883859)
  • Improved measurement performance of single-line LinkAnnotations in BasicText by avoiding Path allocations. (I9ec65, b/572883859)
  • Fixed a crash in Robolectric tests when a text field shows its magnifier, e.g. after two quick clicks on it. (I65095)
  • Improved composition performance of LinkAnnotation in BasicText by avoiding unnecessary coroutine and MutableInteractionSource allocations when stateful link styles are not used. (Ia784d, b/572883859)
  • Fixed a bug where simultaneous stateful styles on multiple LinkAnnotations in BasicText overwrote each other, and improved styling performance from O(N^2) to O(N). (I4f28e, b/572883859)
  • Improved drawing and hit-testing performance of single-line LinkAnnotations in BasicText by bypassing unnecessary path clipping. (Ib7f63, b/572883859)
  • Improved measurement performance of single-line LinkAnnotations in BasicText by avoiding Path allocations. (I4312c, b/572883859)
  • Fixed an issue where active but stationary trackpad gestures could cause unnecessary frame requests (high CPU usage). (I1e879)
  • Updated accessibility node text and text layout results to reflect active text translations (SemanticsProperties.TextSubstitution) when SemanticsProperties.IsShowingTextSubstitution is true. (I006ef)
  • Fixed an issue in LazyGrid where changing item spans dynamically via state could cause an IllegalStateException or item placement errors. (I680b9, b/398125797)
  • Fixed an issue where changing only isNonScrollCachingEnabled on a LazyLayoutCacheWindow had no effect because the windows were considered equal. (I16d57)
  • Fixed long screenshots that show content twice when a scrolling node sits inside pullRefresh or a nested scroll parent. (I2500f)
  • Fixed Modifier.animateItem() animating items off screen when a lazy layout with reverseLayout = true is resized. (I68af6, b/548989579)
  • GridTrackSize.Flex and GridTrackSize.MinMax now throw IllegalArgumentException when given a non-finite Fr weight. (I70728)
  • Modifier.border now supports rendering generic / polygon shapes with a runtime shader, when using the new border implementation. (I128ca)
  • Modifier.border now uses a new more performant implementation. You can disable this using ComposeFoundationFlags.isNewBorderImplementationEnabled. If you run into issues and need to disable this flag, please file a bug. (I4c3b3)

External Contribution

  • Fixed bring-into-view scroll animations that never finished when the BringIntoViewSpec target fell between pixels, such as when focusing a text field in a scrollable container on Android TV. (Ida7b9, b/568935367)
  • Fixed the text selection toolbar remaining visible when the selection no longer has a valid content area. (I92563)
  • Allow reversed (end < start) selection when made via a mouse gesture in a TextField(TextFieldState). Previously it would be automatically made "normal" (start < end). (I42559)
  • Fixed AndroidExternalSurface callbacks after reuse in reusable content. (I8b56c, b/554586999)

entries.name: Compose Material3
entries.html:
Important changes since 1.4.0:

Library change announcements

  • New material3-ripple artifact and Inset Focus Rings: Added the dedicated androidx.compose.material3:material3-ripple artifact as a modern replacement for material-ripple (I1b3a3).

This library adds support for rendering focus states using visual inset focus rings instead of opacity layers. Within material3, this integrates seamlessly via LocalRippleThemeConfiguration (I0551a). Standalone design systems can also depend directly on androidx.compose.material3:material3-ripple.

Behavior Changes

  • Slider and RangeSlider stateful migration & source-breaking parameter change:

    • Stateless overloads of Slider and RangeSlider are deprecated in favor of stateful overloads taking SliderState and RangeSliderState (If8995).
    • Source breaking change: onValueChange is now a required parameter, and its position in the parameter list has changed. Slider and RangeSlider now handle onValueChange and onValueChangeFinished directly in the composable layer rather than passing them through SliderState (I959ac).
    • In RangeSliderState, activeRangeStart and activeRangeEnd have been renamed to startValue and endValue (If8995).

    Migration Example:

    // Before (Stateless)
var value by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0.5f) }
Slider(value = value, onValueChange = { value = it })

// After (Stateful)
val state = remember { SliderState(value = 0.5f) }
Slider(state = state, onValueChange = { /* optional side effects */ })

  • SecureTextField Default Obfuscation Mode: Updated SecureTextField and OutlinedSecureTextField to default to TextObfuscationMode.System rather than TextObfuscationMode.RevealLastTyped (I76c7e).

  • BottomSheet Deterministic Anchor Resolution: ModalBottomSheet and BottomSheetScaffold no longer automatically remove the PartiallyExpanded anchor based on layout height heuristics (Ia4167. Developers explicitly control anchors via rememberBottomSheetState. Sheets also now respect MaterialTheme.motionScheme during nested scrolling and dragging (I5fe22).

  • Navigation Item High-Contrast Label Color: Horizontal NavigationItem labels (e.g. in WideNavigationRail) now calculate color via selectedTextColorStartIconPosition to match selectedIconColor under high-contrast themes (I85855, b/490910896). To revert, set selectedTextColorStartIconPosition = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary.

  • Checkbox Sizing & Alignment: Checkbox box size and indicator marks have been recalibrated to strictly align with the Material 3 specification (I97baf, b/457504316). Flag ComposeMaterial3Flags.isCheckboxStylingFixEnabled is provided to assist testing and rollout.

  • TopAppBarDefaults Scroll Behaviors: pinnedScrollBehavior and enterAlwaysScrollBehavior overloads now take ScrollableState (LazyListState, ScrollState) to resolve reversed layout directions and initially scrolled offsets (Idef9d, I9d5c2). Parameter isAtTop is renamed to isAtStart (If7323).

  • Single Theme Composition Local: MaterialTheme was refactored internally to consolidate theme values into a single composition local (MaterialTheme.LocalMaterialTheme.current) (Idee2e). Deprecated LocalMotionScheme in favor of MaterialTheme.motionScheme (I4b61d).

New Material Design 3 Components

  • Expressive Buttons & Button Groups:
    • ToggleButton, ElevatedToggleButton, FilledTonalToggleButton, and OutlinedToggleButton: Toggle buttons featuring expressive shape morphing, ButtonSize, and icon slots (Iab484).
    • SplitButton: Expressive split button combining a primary action button and a trailing menu/dropdown trigger, replacing SplitButtonLayout (Ic9840).
    • ButtonGroup: Container for grouped buttons supporting adaptive width squishing via Modifier.animateWidth(compressionLimit = ...) and overflow indicators (I8ef39, I6e67c).
  • Expressive Text Fields:
    • TextField and OutlinedTextField expressive styling options featuring TextFieldDefaults.roundedShape, tonalColors(), and TextFieldLabelPosition.Inside / Cutout label placement (Id9185, I40f62).
  • Expressive Chips:
    • FilterChip, ElevatedFilterChip, and InputChip with shape-morphing selection animations, custom content padding, and horizontalArrangement support (I84717, Ida874).
  • Expressive Menus & Submenus:
    • SelectableDropdownMenuItem and CheckableDropdownMenuItem: Expressive menu items supporting radio and checkbox selection semantics, supporting text, and vibrant colors (I160ca, I89e4b).
    • DropdownMenuPopupPositionProvider: Enables anchor-relative popup positioning for nested cascading submenus (Ic1ace).
  • Expressive Time Pickers & Pickers:
    • VibrantTimePickerDialog: Expressive time picker dialog supporting both dial and uncontained scroll/input modes (Iea5aa, I2b3b6).
    • Scrollable TimePicker variant and ScrollField: Wheel/scroll picker variant for rapid numeric selection with full keyboard and screen reader accessibility (I46f6b, Iab612).
  • Sheets and Scrims:
    • Standalone static Sheet component (Experimental): Non-modal static surface for anchored bottom and side sheets (I0ef95).
    • Standalone Scrim: Decoupled scrim composable for use across modal sheets, dialogs, and custom containers (I29555).
  • Wavy Progress Indicators:
    • WavyLinearProgressIndicator and WavyCircularProgressIndicator: Expressive wavy paths for determinate and indeterminate loading indications (Id72a3).
  • Loading Indicators (Experimental):
    • LoadingIndicator and ContainedLoadingIndicator: Expressive loading indicators that morph smoothly across a sequence of RoundedPolygon shapes in both determinate (progress) and indeterminate modes, customizable via LoadingIndicatorDefaults (and supported as a pull-to-refresh indicator via PullToRefreshDefaults.LoadingIndicator).
  • Material Shapes (Experimental):
    • MaterialShapes: Provides 35 predefined, normalized Material Design 3 shapes as RoundedPolygons (including Circle, Square, Slanted, Arch, Oval, Pill, Sunny, Cookie4Sided–Cookie12Sided, Clover4Leaf, Clover8Leaf, Burst, SoftBurst, Flower, Puffy, and Heart), along with toShape and toPath extensions to convert RoundedPolygon and Morph instances into Compose Shape and Path objects.
  • Toolbars & List Items:
    • FloatingToolbar and HorizontalFloatingToolbar: Expressive floating toolbars with built-in overflow handling (I5a4d8, I6a6f8).
    • Expressive and Segmented ListItem: Interactive and non-interactive list item variants with rounded container segmenting (I54057, I2836a).
    • Added support for verticalAlignment in interactive ListItem, allowing custom alignment of content (Id69ec6).
    • Added InteractiveListItem documentation and performed renames of internal components to ListItem for improved developer ergonomics (Ib70923).
  • Enabled customizing list items vertical alignment via InteractiveListItemDefaults.verticalAlignment() (Id69ec6).
  • Search Variants:
    • AppBarWithSearch (Experimental): Seamless integration of top app bar navigation with a search field (I213a5).
    • ExpandedDockedSearchBarWithGap and ExpandedFullScreenContainedSearchBar: Expansion variants for tablet and large-screen search experiences (Idb7f8, Ie472d).

Enhancements to existing Material Design 3 components

  • Accessibility & Keyboard Navigation: Overhauled keyboard navigation and focus traversal across DatePickers (grid, year selector), TimePickers (dial numbers, AM/PM buttons), Sliders, Scaffolds, and NavigationDrawers (Ibba27, I77194).
  • Theming & Styling: Graduated the Expressive theming (MaterialTheme.expressiveLightColorScheme, MaterialTheme.materialExpressTheme) (I40eab, bringing expressive design tokens, shapes, and color configurations across components.
  • Typography: Added constructor overloads to Typography that accept a defaultFontFamily, propagating the font family to all unset styles in the type scale (I2e305,
  • Text: Added Text composable overloads taking a ColorProducer lambda to animate or update text color during the draw phase without triggering recomposition (I9ff25,
  • Carousels:
    • Added multi-aspect carousel support via the Modifier.carouselParallaxScrollEffect and LazyGrid integration (I46b17, I2b109).
    • Renamed maxItemWidth to preferredItemWidth in HorizontalCenteredHeroCarousel (Ie7883).
    • Added CarouselDefaults.ItemSpacing and CarouselDefaults.ContentPadding (I2f36a).
  • Tooltips:
    • Added custom caret shape configuration and expanded TooltipPositionProvider to anchor tooltips above, below, left, or right (Ie513c).

  • TopAppBarScrollBehavior and top app bar variants (TopAppBar, MediumFlexibleTopAppBar, LargeTopAppBar, TwoRowsTopAppBar) (Ieb2d1, Iea5aa)

  • Core Slider and RangeSlider APIs (I5efb3)
  • Multi-browse and uncontained Carousel APIs (I7a558)

Remaining experimental APIs

Slider and RangeSlider

  • Fixed PullToRefreshDefaults.LoadingIndicator drawing an empty container on the first frame of a pull. (Ia87cf)

ScrollField

entries.name: Compose Runtime
entries.html:
Important changes since 1.12.0:

ComputedState API

We've introduced a new computedStateOf { } API that can be used as an alternative to derivedStateOf.

Like DerivedState, ComputedState is an implementation of State whose value is backed by a calculation that may read other states. The value will invalidate when the result of the calculation changes, not when one of the referenced states changes.

The primary difference between ComputedState and DerivedState is that DerivedState caches the result of its calculation and ComputedState executes the calculation on-demand each time the value is read. For many calculations, this caching is more expensive than computing the value on-demand. Therefore, we recommend using ComputedState instead of DerivedState when your calculation doesn't benefit from caching. Good candidates for calculations that don't benefit from caching are ones that don't rely on object identity of its result, don't allocate large objects, don't read many states, aren't read many times in a single frame, and don't perform a complex algorithm.

As a general rule of thumb, we recommend using ComputedState instead of DerivedState for most usages and if it's unclear whether caching would be beneficial.

Updates to the Experimental SlotTable

The LinkComposer remains opt-in as of Compose 1.13, and includes fixes for several issues reported since Compose 1.12. We continue to recommend testing your app against the new implementation of the SlotTable and reporting any issues you run into.

Note that in runtime version 1.13.0-alpha01, the proguard syntax for enabling the LinkComposer in minified builds has changed. See the feature flag documentation and previous release notes for more information.

entries.name: Compose Runtime
entries.html:
API Changes

  • Parent snapshots are now advanced when a nested snapshot is taken. When snapshot writes are made to the same state object in both snapshots, the parent snapshot's writes will now appear to be after writes in the child, and will appear in the final snapshot when applied. This behavior can be disabled via the flag ComposeRuntimeFlags.advanceParentSnapshotsWhenTakingNestedSnapshot. (I30263, b/573222121)
  • Added the Snapshot.readOnly { } API (I5feef)
  • MutableVector and mutableVectorOf are deprecated. Use androidx.collection.MutableObjectList and mutableObjectListOf instead. (If0dd8)
  • Removed the watchosArm32 target, which Kotlin 2.5 no longer supports. (Ic048d)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed SnapshotStateObserver still notifying a cleared scope when its first observation nested an observation of the same scope. (Ie7789)
  • Fixed an issue in the GapComposer and LinkComposer that could cause a crash when nodes are modified around the end of an inlined node's group boundary (I173fe, b/569219194)
  • Fixed an issue where a CompositionLocal could be read incorrectly if placed after a MovableContent instance that is removed from composition. (I8100a, b/574059467)
  • Fixed an issue in the LinkTable that could recompose content out of order when keyed items are inserted and removed in the same frame (I4acc7)
  • Updated androidx.tracing:tracing-wire dependency to 2.0.5. (I70e9f)
  • Documented that scheduleFrameEndCallback throws CancellationException when the Recomposer shuts down. (Iae38a, b/568852322)
  • Fixed an issue where disposing a parent MutableSnapshot while a nested snapshot remained active could prematurely unpin state records and cause subsequent reads of modified states to throw an IllegalStateException. (If2887, b/573733481)
  • Fixed a race condition in derivedStateOf where concurrent state updates could cause reading a derived state to throw a spurious IllegalStateException. (I3861b, b/574107950)
  • Fixed a memory leak in LinkComposer where skipped conditional invalidations and invalidated scopes removed by ancestor recomposition were retained in the composer's invalidations map. (Idffd0)
  • Fixed a bug where applying a NestedMutableSnapshot with merged state records could leak an open snapshot ID and read unmerged state in the parent snapshot. (I544a7, b/570652672)
  • Fixed a bug in SnapshotIdSet.andNot where sets sharing a belowBound array retained cleared snapshot IDs. (Ie881e, b/570534659)

External Contribution

  • Fixed an issue where a state change applied while a PausedComposition was composing its initial content on another thread was not reflected when the composition was applied. (I52618)

API Changes

This fix is gated by AndroidComposeUiFlags.isNestedScrollInteropMeasureAndLayoutEnabled. (I57434)

  • Added Modifier.illuminate, IlluminationScope, and Modifier.lightAnchor to apply lighting effects to composables and anchor light positions to layout coordinates. (If829a)
  • Adds Light (DirectionalLight, SpotLight and PointLight), SurfaceMaterial, SurfaceGeometrySpec. (I8fd41)
  • Added DrawAnnotation for custom drawing behind and over AnnotatedString text ranges. (I928bf)
  • Added computedMediaQuery API, which offers better performance over derivedMediaQuery for calculations that don't benefit from caching. derivedMediaQuery is now deprecated. (Idacbf)

  • Fixed an issue where AndroidView (and AndroidFragment) dropped nested scroll and fling deltas when the root hosted View was a container ViewGroup (such as FrameLayout, FragmentContainerView, or CoordinatorLayout) with isNestedScrollingEnabled == false wrapping a nested scrolling child (such as RecyclerView). To disable View-to-Compose nested scrolling, call ViewCompat.setNestedScrollingEnabled(view, false) on the nested scrolling child View itself. This fix is gated by AndroidComposeUiFlags.isNestedScrollInteropViewHolderFixEnabled. (I74782)

  • Add missing pixel 10, 9a and 11 pro fold devices (If7aa5)

  • Added multiTouchSwipeWithVelocity to TouchInjectionScope to allow testing multi-touch gestures with a specific end velocity. (If0966)

  • Material 3 TextField and OutlinedTextField overloads that accept value, onValueChange parameters, along with TextFieldDefaults.DecorationBox and OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.DecorationBox, are deprecated in favor of the TextFieldState overloads and decorator APIs. (Idb68b, b/554049628)

Feature Flag removals
  • Removed AndroidComposeUiFlags.isAccessibilityPerformanceEnabled. (I2a70e, b/529420099)
  • Removed ComposeUiFlags.isMinimalistLocalsEnabled. (Ibc870, b/523295932)
  • Removed the feature flag ComposeUiFlags.isClippedTouchBoundsOcclusionFixEnabled (Id9e0a)
  • Removed the temporary feature flag AndroidComposeUiFlags.isDelayedWindowInsetsRulersEnabled. (I722b7)
  • Removed ComposeUiFlags.isTrackpadPinchReinterpretationEnabled. (I39fef)
  • Removed ComposeUiTestFlags and the temporary ComposeUiTestFlags.isMainThreadTestSynchronizationEnabledForDeviceTests flag. Main-thread synchronization in Compose device tests is now permanently enabled. (I765e9)
  • Removed the feature flag AndroidComposeUiFlags.isPropagateHideFromAccessibilityToMergingChildrenEnabled (Ief6fa)
  • Removes experimental feature flag ComposeUiFlags.isTrackpadPanHoverFixEnabled. (I3aa5b)
  • Removed the feature flag AndroidComposeUiFlags.isTraversalGroupSortingEnabled (I18b92)

Bug Fixes

  • Map HintText semantics to ViewStructure.setHint in Autofill. (If6bcc)
  • Fixed a crash in Robolectric tests when a text field shows its magnifier, e.g. after two quick clicks on it. (I65095)
  • Fixed an unnecessary remeasurement when reading an alignment line during measurement and placing the child with a non-zero offset. (I363ab, b/435377724)
  • Updated accessibility node text and text layout results to reflect active text translations (SemanticsProperties.TextSubstitution) when SemanticsProperties.IsShowingTextSubstitution is true. (I006ef)
  • Fixed screen reader focus resets in LazyRow, LazyColumn, and LazyGrid by setting pixel scrollDeltaX and scrollDeltaY on TYPE_VIEW_SCROLLED events. (I463bc, b/330744631)
  • Fixed a long screenshot crash on Android 12 when a captured frame is read before it presents. (I0f9ec)
  • Fixed an issue where indirect pointer events and cancellations were not dispatched to multiple delegated IndirectPointerInputModifierNodes or to IndirectPointerInputModifierNodes chained after a focus target in the same modifier chain. (I0f15a)

External Contribution

  • onVisibilityChanged and onFirstVisible no longer report content as visible while it is outside of the window, when its ComposeView isn't at the window's origin, such as in a RecyclerView. (Ibb2b6, b/577830524)

  • compileSdk for Compose UI and the Compose libraries that build against it (Animation, Foundation, Material 3, UI Test, UI Tooling, UI ViewBinding and Navigation3 UI) updated to 37.2. This will require transitively updating compileSdk for all apps and libraries using them. (I2859d)
  • Fixed an issue on legacy (non-transactional) calls where availableEndpoints could remain empty when Telecom delays or withholds onCallAudioStateChanged. (Ib46b0)
  • Restored the FingerprintManagerCompat implementation that was made a no-op in core 1.18.0. That change caused androidx.biometric 1.1.0 and other callers to report no fingerprint hardware and fail fingerprint authentication on API 29 and lower. isHardwareDetected(), hasEnrolledFingerprints() and authenticate() now delegate to the platform FingerprintManager again. (Id8c84, b/543076354)
  • AccessibilityNodeInfoCompat.MathInfoCompat set with AccessibilityNodeInfoCompat.setStructuredDataInfo is now available to accessibility services through AccessibilityNodeInfoCompat.getStructuredDataInfo below API 37, where it's stored in the node's extras. (If7e95)
  • Normalized DisconnectCause.UNKNOWN to DisconnectCause.LOCAL and handled platform call aborts with DisconnectCause.CANCELED in onDisconnect so that platform-initiated disconnects report consistent causes across API levels. (I3049f)
  • Hardening the ContentPipExt fallback PiP solution. (Id276b)
  • Fixed an issue where video calls on a Bluetooth headset could unexpectedly switch to speakerphone during transient audio route updates. (Ie435a)
  • Bump core-telecom to 1.1.0-rc01. (Iba053)
  • Added @Rotation IntDef to restrict rotation values in ScreenOrientation. (I03bf0)
  • Fixed an issue where video calls started with a preferred audio endpoint (such as the phone earpiece) would erroneously revert to the device speaker shortly after connecting. (I38ea6)
  • Fixed an issue where video calls would incorrectly route audio to the device speaker instead of a connected wired headset on call start. (I575a8)
  • Fixed an issue where manipulating WindowInsetsCompat could sometimes cause an IllegalArgumentException during screen rotation on Android 11 devices. (I68aaf, b/284078031)
  • Allow VoIP apps to disconnect with DisconnectCause.ERROR starting in SDK 38, with automatic remapping to LOCAL on older platform versions. (I5a58c)
  • Bump core-telecom to 1.1.0-beta01. (I5b514)
  • Callback onFinishContentPip if enterPip fails (I04b77)
  • Fixed an issue where CallsManager#addCall could delay CallControlScope entry by up to 2 seconds while waiting for starting audio endpoint resolution and Bluetooth stabilization. (Ia1e89)
  • Fixed a race condition where invoking CallsManager#addCall or CallsManager#addCallWithExtensions while another call setup is in progress could lead to deadlocks or silent failures in the OS TransactionManager. Overlapping call setups are now immediately rejected with CallException(ERROR_CALL_NOT_PERMITTED_AT_PRESENT_TIME). (If0ac8)
  • Fix video calls route to earpiece instead of speaker bug when using the backwards compat path on sdk=34+ (I9f2bd)

  • Catch exception in setPictureInPictureParams (Ibfeb2)
  • Fixed a bug in Core-Telecom where an intentional user switch to speakerphone during call initialization would be incorrectly reverted to the earpiece. (I9e251)

entries.name: Mediarouter
entries.html:
Important changes since 1.8.0:

New Features and API Changes

  • Minimum SDK Bump: The default minimum SDK requirement is now 24.
  • Device Suggestions: Introduced the setDeviceSuggestions API, allowing you to provide device suggestions for dynamic routes.
  • Media Transfer Status: Introduced the isMediaTransferEnabled method in MediaRouter to allow checking the media transfer status programmatically.
  • Routing Controller API: Added an API to fetch the routing controller ID directly from a selected route.
  • Selection Triggers: Added an onSelectedRoute overload that explicitly indicates the selection trigger.
  • Simplified Media Transfer: Enabling media transfer no longer requires a dedicated manifest tag.

Bug Fixes and Improvements

  • UI Polish: Converted MediaRouteExpandCollapseButton and various other UI assets to use vector drawables instead of PNGs for better scaling and performance.
  • Accessibility: Added the button accessibility role to items in MediaRouteChooserDialog so screen readers properly announce route entries as buttons.
  • Security & Crash Prevention: Fixed a potential crash (NullPointerException and ClassCastException) caused by receiving malformed parcels in MediaRouteDescriptor.
  • Screen-off Scanning: Prevented third-party apps from inappropriately requesting screen-off scanning via MediaRouteDiscoveryRequest.
  • Routing Reliability: Fixed several bugs that could cause incorrect route selection or inconsistent default route states when providers change or media transfer is toggled.

entries.name: navigation3
entries.html:
New Features

Dynamic feature modules, a.k.a. Play Feature Delivery, is now integrated to Navigation 3 via androidx.navigation3:navigation3-dynamic-features library.

  • DynamicFeatureNavEntryDecorator takes in a SplitInstallManager to install a dynamic feature module upon first navigation to the module. To use, call rememberDynamicFeatureNavEntryDecorator and pass into the NavDisplay. Then pass in DynamicFeatureNavEntryDecorator.entryProvider as the entryProvider, and invoke dynamicFeatureModule() inside the provider to register the module.(Idfc15, b/520494172)

     val dynamicFeatureDecorator =
    rememberDynamicFeatureNavEntryDecorator<NavKey>(
        splitInstallManager = rememberSplitInstallManager(),
        defaultLoadingContent = { LoadingIndicator() }
    )

 NavDisplay(
    ...
    entryDecorators =
        listOf(
            rememberSaveableStateHolderNavEntryDecorator(),
            dynamicFeatureDecorator,
        ),
    entryProvider =
        dynamicFeatureDecorator.entryProvider {
            entry<HomeKey> {
                ...
            }
            dynamicFeatureModule(
                initialKey = PremiumKey,
                moduleName = "premium",
                entryProviderClassName = "com.example.premium.PremiumModuleEntryProvider",
                loadingContent = { state ->
                    when (state.status()) {
                        SplitInstallSessionStatus.FAILED -> Text("Failure")
                        SplitInstallSessionStatus.REQUIRES_USER_CONFIRMATION -> {
                            // Call SplitInstallManager::startConfirmationDialogForResult
                        }
                        else -> Text("Loading premium feature...") 
                    }
                },
            )
        },
)

  • DynamicFeatureModuleEntryProvider provides NavEntries of the dynamic feature module after the module has been installed. In the module, extend the DynamicFeatureModuleEntryProvider class to create an EntryProvider that will be resolved at runtime via Java reflect. The provider can be registered with NavDisplay by passing its fully qualified name into the dynamicFeatureModule invocation.(Idfc15, b/520494172)

    // Defined in the `:premium` dynamic feature module. 
// Resolved in the `:main` app module by reflection in runtime when
// the installation of the dynamic feature module is completed.
class PremiumModuleEntryProvider : DynamicFeatureModuleEntryProvider<NavKey> {
    override fun EntryProviderScope<NavKey>.buildEntries() {
        entry<PremiumKey> {
            Text("PremiumScreen")
        }
        entry<PremiumSubKey> {
            Text("SubScreen")
        }
    }
}

  • The initial NavKey that is used for navigating to the module can be defined in the main module or a common module. NavKeys for additional sub-screens inside the dynamic feature module can be defined within the module. (Idfc15, b/520494172)

    // Initial nav key for the `:premium` dynamic feature module. 
// Defined in the `:main` app module, but can also be accessed from 
// the dynamic feature module.
@Serializable data object PremiumKey : NavKey

// An internal sub nav key for the `:premium` dynamic feature module. 
// Defined in the `:premium` app module, cannot be accessed by other modules.
@Serializable internal data object PremiumSubKey : NavKey

API Changes

  • Made EntryProviderScope open and EntryProviderScope.build() public to allow extending the entry provider DSL scope. (I6a66d, b/520494172)
  • Added SharedTransitionScope.DeferredTransitionBehavior (FollowContainer, Static, SeekToTarget), SharedContentConfig.deferredTransitionBehavior, and MutableContentTransform.sharedElementProgress to support seeking shared elements toward their target bounds during the deferred phase of a DeferredTransition. Deprecated permitTransformDuringDeferredTransition. (I2fac2)
  • Removed the watchosArm32 target, which Kotlin 2.5 no longer supports. (Ic048d)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed ConcurrentModificationException from calling NavBackStack.toList() on a background thread while mutating the back stack on the Main thread. NavBackStack now has a custom toList() that delegates to the internal SnapshotStateList's thread-safe toList(). (Id9bb7, b/576097101)

entries.name: Wear Compose
entries.html:
API Changes

  • Added DurationPicker, a new component for Wear Compose Material 3 which allows users to select a duration (as opposed to the existing TimePicker which should be used only to select a time). Also added a PickerGroupScope.PickerGroupItem overload with a gradientColor parameter. TimePickerType.MinutesSeconds has been deprecated, and DurationPicker should be used with DurationPickerType.MinutesSeconds instead. (I4bc8c)
  • Renamed Modifier.curveToEdge to Modifier.drawCurvedToEdge and added DrawCurvedToEdgeDefaults for recommended sweep angles. (Ic2e07)
  • Added AlertDialogDefaults.EdgeButton and AlertDialogDefaults.ConfirmButton overloads with a new gestureVisibilityThreshold parameter, used to configure how much of the button must be visible before the associated one-handed gesture is enabled. Setting gestureVisibilityThreshold to zero turns the gesture off on that button. (I39d87)
  • Rotary and fling snapping of TransformingLazyColumn now step through tall items in several snaps instead of skipping to their center in a single snap. By default, an item taller than the band around the center of a round screen in which it is fully visible is split into equal segments, each with its own snap point. The new Modifier.snapSegmentThreshold in TransformingLazyColumnItemScope customizes how an item is split, or keeps it whole if the threshold >= measuredHeight. With a snap offset, a slow release now snaps the item nearest to the snap line rather than to the center, and a fling faster than 400dp/s always moves on to the next snap point in its direction. Rotary input before a snap scrolls the list linearly, and turning against a running snap cancels it. (Ic5e66)
  • Added a scrollFraction parameter to OneHandedGestureDefaults.scrollDown() to configure how far each gesture scrolls as a fraction of the viewport height. (I2973d)

Bug Fixes

  • compileSdk for Compose UI and all Compose libraries that build against it (including Wear Compose libraries) have been updated to 37.2. This will require transitively updating compileSdk for all apps and libraries using them. (I2859d)
  • Custom accessibility actions added via Modifier.semantics on SplitCheckboxButton, SplitSwitchButton, and SplitRadioButton (for example when used with SwipeToReveal) are now propagated to the focusable primary clickable container Row, so that TalkBack announces available actions. (Ibfebe)
  • Fixed a crash in ButtonGroup when expansionWidth exceeds a neighbor's width, or when either spacing or content padding exceeds the group's available width. (Id3bdf)
  • Wear Compose Material 3 Dialog now supports predictive back gestures from API 36 onwards, providing haptic feedback at the dismiss threshold and matching Navigation 3 exit transitions. (Id4c7c)
  • Fixed a memory leak where the last revealed SwipeToReveal item kept its removed screen in memory. (Ied8b5)
  • Fixed an issue where ButtonGroupScope modifiers (weight, minWidth, animateWidth) never compared equal, causing unnecessary node updates and remeasurement on recomposition. (I5e95d)
  • Fixed an issue where Modifier.oneHandedGesture called onGestureAvailable again whenever the caller recomposed, resulting in repeated gesture indicator hints. The indicator hint is now only shown on the initial composition. (I0b514)
  • Ensure onSwipePrimaryAction is triggered on full swipe in SwipeToReveal (Ia01ba)
  • Fixed an issue where circular screen paddings, transformation specs, and component dimensions in Wear Compose Material 3 shrunk when the Wear OS Global Status Bar reduced Configuration.screenHeightDp. Wear Compose Material3 now uses the screenWidthDp (rather than screenHeightDp) as the screen size, which does not shrink. (I34567)
  • Improved AlertDialog performance by avoiding double composition when content fits on the screen. Note that AlertDialog slots (icon, title, and text) are now measured with unbounded maximum height when content fits on the screen (matching the scrollable case), so Modifier.fillMaxSize() and Modifier.fillMaxHeight() applied inside those slots will no longer expand vertically. (I8963d)
  • Fixed a one-frame flash of the system status bar when AppScaffold enters composition. (Ic0e83)
  • Fixed an IllegalStateException crash in SwipeToReveal when subcomposed inside a LookaheadScope (such as inside a TransformingLazyColumn). (I12b5b)

  • Add press width animation support (expansionWidth and RemoteButtonGroupScope.animateWidth()) to RemoteButtonGroup in Wear Remote Compose Material 3. (Ie2909)
  • Updated RemoteShape overrides to use RemoteLayoutDirection.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed RemoteCircularProgressIndicator so full-circle indicators (startAngle == endAngle) close the gap seamlessly at progress = 1f, and sub-gap indicator and track sweeps scale smoothly down to 0 without leaving stray round endcap dots at progress = 0f or 1f. (I8158e)

entries.name: Jetpack Compose for XR
entries.html:
API Changes

  • Remove deprecated Orbiter APIs, use the Orbiter API accepting an OrbiterPosition instead. (Ib5043)

Bug Fixes

  • Restore original scale when SubspaceModifier.scale is removed (I55b74)
  • Reset a composable with the movable and anchorable modifiers when updating or removing the modifier (Iaee5b)
  • Fixed a bug where scale modifier was not being applied properly to a SpatialModel (I130b2)
  • Fixed an issue where the system movable was not being reset when updated or removed. (I2cb89)
  • Restore original alpha when SubspaceModifier.alpha is removed (Id4902)
  • Update resizable minimumSize default to a 150.dp width/height, as it could be difficult to re-enlarge panels if they apparoach a zero size (old default). (I183a6)
  • Fixes resizable behavior when maintainAspectRatio = true, and a minimumSize and/or maximumSize are set. The resizable will now hit its size cap once a min/max on either axis has been hit, rather than breaking aspect ratio to hit the min/max of both axis. (I89793)
  • Add constraints to clamp SpatialPanel and other panel-like Composables to a safe rendering size. The default max size for the resizable modifier is updated to this size. This max is dynamically calculated, but is substantially larger than the recommended content box size. Larger resizable sizes can still be explicitly specified for layout groups and SpatialExternalSurface but clamping will still apply for any SpatialPanel children they may have. (If408a)
  • Fixed an issue where isSystemMoveOngoing remained true when a MovableComponent was disabled mid-drag, preventing subsequent layout pose updates. Reset isSystemMoveOngoing, previousPose, and previousScale in disableComponent(). (I090f25)

entries.name: Material Design for XR
entries.html:
API Changes

  • Renamed OrbiterAlignment to OrbiterPosition and added support for configuring independent horizontal and vertical edge alignments on Orbiter corner alignment subclasses. Deprecated OrbiterEdgeOffsetType in favor of EdgeAlignment. (Ib2fbc)
  • Prefix Material XR components with Spatial (I0e645)
  • Remove EnableXrComponentOverrides (I09652)
  • Remove Component Override APIs for NavigationSuiteScaffold (Ie6340)
  • Remove Component Override APIs for ThreePaneScaffold (I9ceb5)
  • Remove AnimatedSpatialVisibility and associated usages (I1dffa)
  • Deprecated FloatingToolbarScrollBehavior.floatingScrollBehavior extension function in favor of val floatingScrollBehaviorModifier: Modifier property. (Ifbbec)
  • Update Material to use new Orbiter API and OrbiterEdgeOffsetType API (Ifa085)
  • Remove ComponentOverride APIs (I3784b)
  • Introduced a new Orbiter API variant using SpatialAlignment, DpVolumeOffset, and OrbiterOffsetType for true 3D spatial placement using continuous layout biases. The previous OrbiterAnchorPoint-based variant has been deprecated (Ibdcb5)
  • Make Animation/Transition Apis experimental (I07d98)
  • Update resizable modifier to use a ResizePolicy instead of two modifiers (I7fb0f)
  • Added movable overload with movePolicy param and deprecate transformingMovable and movable (Ic88c1)
  • Deprecated ResizePolicy and the old resizable modifier, replacing it with a new SubspaceModifier.resizable overload and SubspaceModifier.transformingResizable. (I9e4bc)

Bug Fixes

  • Updated Compose dependencies in Material 3 to 1.13.0-alpha03. (I6f41b)
  • compileSdk for Compose libraries updated to 37.1. This will require transitively updating compileSdk for all apps and libraries using Compose. (I05b0f)

entries.name: Jetpack SceneCore
entries.html:
New Features

  • Added support for resizable geometry interactions to GltfEntity and MeshEntity components. (Id57fa)
  • Added support for dynamically updating the looping state of GltfAnimation during playback. (Ib0dd7)

API Changes

  • Added PointSourceParams.Builder with directivity, spread angle, and DistanceAttenuation models for 3D spatial audio point sources. (Ib3737)
  • The GltfAnimation.setLoop() API is no longer marked as experimental as it can now toggle the looping behavior while the animation is playing. (I6da98, I67be6)

Bug Fixes

  • ResizableComponent can now be attached to a GltfModelEntity to let the user scale the model. (I5c3e4)
  • AnchorSpace now transitions to AnchorSpace.State.ERROR when anchor token export or binding fails. (I91169)
  • Synchronized PanelEntity resizing by using transaction callbacks to eliminate visual flickering during scaling. (I8f803)
  • Fixed corner radius clamping issue when resizing quad SurfaceEntity shapes by ensuring values remain within bounds. (I74283)
